goal: Add slug creation, tagged note storage, search, JSON export, and documentation. Make python -m pytest pass.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic slug creation
tasks.description: Create benchmark_app.slug.slugify with lowercase ASCII-style hyphenated slugs.
acceptance_criteria: slugify produces local-agent-tea for the acceptance example

tasks.title: Implement tagged note storage
tasks.description: Create deterministic note records and an in-memory NoteStore with sorted tags.
acceptance_criteria: NoteStore.add and NoteStore.all satisfy the acceptance test

tasks.title: Implement note search
tasks.description: Search note titles, bodies, and tags case-insensitively.
acceptance_criteria: search_notes returns matching notes in stable input order

tasks.title: Implement deterministic JSON export
tasks.description: Export note records as compact JSON with deterministic key and list ordering.
acceptance_criteria: export_json exactly matches the acceptance fixture

tasks.title: Document the completed note package
tasks.description: Update the README with package usage after all features exist.
acceptance_criteria: README documents slug, storage, search, and export
